split_rule: 70/15/15 exact base-sequence groups sorted by salted SHA256; modifications stay together
validation_roles: first half validation groups selection, remaining half calibration, disjoint
selection_metric: selection MAE; candidates ascending, first minimum
fit_rule: Train only; never refit using validation

conformal.score: maximum absolute residual within exact base-sequence group
conformal.quantile: ceil((n_calibration_groups+1)*0.9) order statistic; no test information
conformal.coverage_claim: empirical diagnostic; exchangeability and parent homology not established

bootstrap.groups: exact base sequence with all PTM variants

limitations: No parent-protein or homologous-family mapping; no new-family generalization claim
Target-domain diagnostic only; original PXD005573 source A2 HOLD remains unchanged
Not DeepLC paper reproduction; original source iRT is never used as minutes
